_: SRD 5.2.1 level 3 spells, CC-BY-4.0. Ranges are in squares: one square is five feet. A spell marked 'approximated' never ships under its SRD name.

effects.note: SRD 5.2.1: the caster makes a Constitution save; on a failure the spell fails, the action is wasted, and a slot it used is not expended

SRD 5.2.1: one creature, object or magical effect within range. Every spell of level 3 or lower on it ends; a higher one ends on a spellcasting check against 10 + its level. Cast with a slot of 4+, a spell of that level or lower ends outright
or a magical effect on the board: every spell holding the aimed square

SRD 5.2.1 (SRD p.133): a willing creature you touch gains a Fly Speed of 60 feet and can hover, concentration up to 10 minutes. v1 has no altitude: flying is its speed of 60 for the duration, and it passes over difficult ground and zones on the ground. It never falls. Kept under the SRD name by Kathleen (2026-09-25) without the extra creature per slot level above 3

SRD 5.2.1: speed doubled, +2 AC, advantage on Dex saves, and one extra action each turn for a single weapon attack, Dash, Disengage, Hide or Utilize (Utilize is an object interaction the fight does not model)
when the spell ends: Incapacitated and a Speed of 0 until the end of its next turn
SRD 5.2.1: a 30-foot cube; a creature that can see it makes a Wis save or is Charmed - Incapacitated with a Speed of 0 - until it takes damage or someone uses an action to shake it

SRD 5.2.1 (SRD p.163): up to six creatures of your choice in a 40-foot Cube within 120 feet, Wis save. An affected target's Speed is halved, it takes -2 to AC and Dex saves, can't take Reactions, takes an action or a Bonus Action but not both, and makes only one attack with the Attack action; it repeats the save at the end of each of its turns. Not carried: the 25 percent chance a spell with a Somatic component fails - v1 doesn't track components (Kathleen, 2026-09-25)
SRD 5.2.1: a 15-foot emanation that moves with you; the creatures you choose (your side) are spared

SRD 5.2.1: when the emanation reaches a creature, or it enters or ends its turn there - once per turn: Wis save, 3d8 Radiant (good or neutral caster) or Necrotic (evil), half on a success. v1 has no alignment rule for it, so the caster picks at the cast
SRD 5.2.1: any other creature's Speed is halved in the Emanation
